loadFailed: Environmental status could not be loaded. Check the connection, permissions, and backend support.
serviceStopped: Environmental automation is not running. Saved settings do not mean camera changes have been applied.

weatherDisabledHint: Enter your US ZIP code and enable weather below to use modeled conditions.
zipCodeNotFound: The ZIP code could not be matched to a US locality. Check it and save again. No fallback location is used.
zipLocationHint: Enter a US ZIP code or ZIP+4. Weather uses an approximate locality for the first five digits, not your street address. Advanced coordinates are optional and are ignored while a ZIP code is set.
profileApplyFailed: The desired profile could not be applied. Check automation status and logs; no successful camera change is assumed.
noCameraProfiles: Define this camera's named profile overrides in Profiles before selecting them here.
physicalDevelopment: These controls currently apply Frigate analysis profiles. Automated physical-camera image controls are still under development and remain disabled.
editProfiles: Manage profile definitions and camera overrides
modelInterval: Precipitation amounts are per model sample. Provider interval: {{seconds}} seconds.
